day_shape: 83 items: heavy Khamenei messaging cycle around 'Country-loving Medallists' event and SNSC meeting, Jordanian airstrikes in southern Syria after Karak church attack, Kuwait death sentences over Iran-linked plot, Bessent predicts >25% Iran GDP contraction, IDF denies Zamir-Netanyahu Iran rift, Israeli election eve.

threads.label: Khamenei messaging around medallists event
threads.summary: Khamenei's office published a sequence of posts around the 'Country-loving Medallists' ceremony, including a message to scientific and sports medallists framing elites as central to a 'strong Iran' after the 'third imposed war'. Defa Press and IRIB amplified reactions from media activists and senior clerical figures including Judiciary head Mohseni Ejehei.

threads.label: SNSC meeting and Iran deterrence messaging
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB reported SNSC Secretary Mohsen Rezaei met Khamenei, with the Supreme Leader quoted emphasising 'realising Iran's conditions aimed at ending the war'. Parallel Defa Press commentary from Commander Sanaii-rad and analyst Hanizadeh asserted Iran would respond to further US or Israeli action with 'new surprises' and strikes on regional interests.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and shipping pressure
threads.summary: Defa Press framed the Strait of Hormuz as Iran's 'strategic lever' citing Obama remarks and warned of capability to cut undersea internet cables, while the Persian Gulf Waterway Management Authority warned Sinocor Shipping Company vessels face action from 1 November. Iran International reported hardliners in Tehran citing oil-price surges as validating shipping pressure.

threads.label: Regional diplomacy and Iran-linked plots
threads.summary: Iran International reported Tehran hosting Saudi, Turkish and Pakistani officials for security talks described by one analyst as a possible 'last chance' before military action, while Kayhan warned the initiative could relieve US pressure. A Kuwaiti court sentenced three to death over an Iran- and Hezbollah-linked plot to assassinate Interior Minister Sheikh Fahad Al-Yousef Al-Sabah; an Iraqi court ordered arrest of a provincial leader over Iran border-crossing tensions.

threads.label: Israeli election eve and Iran-Netanyahu row
threads.summary: The IDF publicly denied media reports of a confrontation between the political leadership and Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir over Iran, as Trump urged Israelis to re-elect Netanyahu to 'finish the job' against Iran. Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post coverage framed Tuesday's vote around the Iran question, with Iran International reporting Iranian Netanyahu supporters pinning hopes on his re-election.

threads.label: IDF Gaza and West Bank operations
threads.summary: The IDF announced strikes killing four Hamas and Palestinian Islamic Jihad operatives in Gaza over the weekend, including a Nukhba cell commander and a sniper, plus three terrorists emerging from a Khan Younis tunnel beyond the 'Yellow Line'. Troops also uncovered a 15-metre-deep excavation near Hebron linked to the Judea Junction attack that killed Staff Sgt Ron Yonatan Roytman and Sgt Yuval Shai Svilem, and apprehended an Egyptian who crossed the border near Nitzana.

threads.label: Iran economy under pressure
threads.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told Iran International he expects Iran's economy to contract by more than 25% in the year to March 2027 and urged Iranians to stock up on fuel. Iran International also reported flour shortages closing bakeries across Iran, two Iran Air retirees dying after foregoing treatment, and IRIB confirmed Tehran's stock index fell 143,000 units to 7.927 million.

events.title: Outbound Investment Security Program Regulations
events.summary: This proposed rule sets forth regulations that would implement Subtitle C of the Comprehensive Outbound Investment National Security Act, which is codified at Title VIII of the Defense Production Act. The proposed rule would require United States persons to provide notification to the U.S. Department of the Treasury regarding certain transactions involving foreign persons that are engaged in notifiable technologies; and prohibit United States persons from engaging in certain other transactions involving foreign persons that are engaged in prohibited technologies. Where consistent with Title VIII, the proposed rule incorporates certain definitions and concepts from the current regulations governing the Outbound Investment Security Program. The proposed rule also would add applicability dates to the regulations, such that those regulations would continue to apply to activities that occurred within the relevant timeframe.
